sloka: को हि धर्मार्थयोर्हीनमीदृशं कर्म किल्बिषम् ।स्त्रिया: प्रियं चिकीर्षु: सन् कुर्याद्धर्मज्ञ धर्मवित् ॥ २.१०६.१२॥
transliteration: ko hi dharmārthayorhīnamīdṛśaṁ karma kilbiṣam ।striyā: priyaṁ cikīrṣu: san kuryāddharmajña dharmavit ॥ 2.106.12॥

translations.english: O Rama, conversant with righteousness, will any one who knows the meaning of righteousness, do such a sinful act contrary to dharma and artha to please a woman?
